name: Ch’en K’o
bio: Ch’en K’o (陳克; Chen Ke; 1081–1137) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The 2 ci here are from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 菩萨蛮（赤阑桥尽香街直） (Pu sa man)
poems.author: Ch’en K’o
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
赤阑桥尽香街直。
笼街细柳娇无力。
金碧上青空。
花晴帘影红。
黄衫飞白马。
日日青楼下。
醉眼不逢人。
午香吹暗尘。

poems.title: 菩萨蛮（绿芜墙绕青苔院） (Pu sa man)
poems.author: Ch’en K’o
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
绿芜墙绕青苔院。
中庭日淡芭蕉卷。
蝴蝶上阶飞。
烘帘自在垂。
玉钩双语燕。
宝甃杨花转。
几处簸钱声。
绿窗春睡轻。
